title: Maximum Score After Splitting a String
description: Given a binary string `s` of length at least 2 consisting of `'0'` and `'1'`, return the maximum score achievable after splitting `s` into two non-empty substrings (a left prefix and a right suffix). The score of a split is the number of `'0'`s in the left substring plus the number of `'1'`s in the right substring.
hints: Total score = zeros_left + (total_ones - ones_left) = total_ones + (zeros_left - ones_left).
Precompute total_ones (or track zeros_left - ones_left in a single pass up to index n - 2).

examples.explanation: Splitting "011101" into "0" and "11101" gives 1 zero + 4 ones = 5.
Splitting "00111" into "00" and "111" gives 2 zeros + 3 ones = 5.
Splitting "1111" into "1" and "111" gives 0 zeros + 3 ones = 3.
